mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Non-Resident Corporate Shareholder (Certified True Copy)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar / Companies Registry in the foreign shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route: home notary public to competent Apostille authority in the shareholder's state, then direct submission to Chinese authorities; Consular route (non-member state): home notary public to home Ministry of Foreign Affairs to Chinese Embassy/Consulate legalization. The two routes are parallel alternatives; sequential Apostille-plus-Consular legalization is prohibited.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Active Status of the Non-Resident Corporate Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of Companies or equivalent official registry in the shareholder's home country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certificate must be issued within 90 days before submission. If the issuing state is an Apostille Convention member, apply apostille by the designated competent authority; if it is a non-member state, use home Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication followed by Chinese Embassy/Consulate legalization. Never chain apostille and consular legalization together.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution of the Non-Resident Corporate Shareholder Approving the WFOE Formation and Power of Attorney to the Local Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors / corporate governing body of the foreign shareholder, authenticated by the company secretary or a local notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route: execute board resolution, notarize before home notary, obtain Apostille from home competent authority, then file directly; Consular route: execute board resolution, notarize, authenticate through home Ministry of Foreign Affairs, then legalize at Chinese Embassy/Consulate. The two optional chains are mutually exclusive and must not be applied cumulatively.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Charter of the Non-Resident Corporate Shareholder (Certified Copy)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the foreign shareholder's jurisdiction (certified by the registrar)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille member state: certified copy from registry, notary certification if required, Apostille by competent authority; non-member state: certified copy from registry, home Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication, Chinese Embassy/Consulate legalization. These are parallel paths; neither requires the other.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the Non-Resident Corporate Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relationship bank of the foreign shareholder (issued under authorized signatories)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Letter issued on bank letterhead and signed by a branch manager; signature verified by notary and the relevant chamber or competent authority. If the bank's state is an Apostille member, apostillize the letter; if not, submit it to the home Ministry of Foreign Affairs and then the Chinese Embassy/Consulate for legalization. Apostille and consular legalization are alternative routes and must not be combined.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All non-resident shareholders, underlying beneficial owners, directors, senior managers and authorized signatories must be screened against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU/HM Treasury sanctions lists, China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs sanctions designation list, the PRC Unreliable Entity List and the domestic politically exposed persons (PEP) database maintained by the People's Bank of China under the 2025 AML Law. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for PEPs, their immediate family members and close associates, including independent source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification. Positive hits trigger a Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) filing through the China Anti-Money Laundering Monitoring and Analysis Center, and the proposed WFOE structure must be rejected or restructured.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) Enterprise Name Declaration and Pre-approval online module, integrated into the National Enterprise Registration Service Platform and accessible through provincial SAMR portals
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under the SAMR Enterprise Name Registration and Administration Measures, a company name must follow the four-tier structure: (1) administrative division, (2) distinctive trade name (zihao), (3) industry or business characteristics, and (4) organizational form such as 'Limited Liability Company'. The statutory registered name must be written in simplified Standard Chinese characters; pinyin or English may only be used as a supplementary name and never as the official Chinese name. A foreign investor's corporate name must be transliterated into simplified Chinese using a standard phonetic equivalent. Traditional Chinese characters are not accepted in the official Chinese name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the SAMR rejects a proposed name, the applicant may amend and resubmit the name directly through the same online portal. Within 60 days of the rejection date, the applicant may also submit a written administrative reconsideration application to the next-higher market regulation administration, attaching the rejection notice, the proposed Chinese name, the four-tier breakdown and the translator's certificate. If the reconsideration decision is adverse, the applicant may file an administrative lawsuit with the competent Intermediate People's Court within 6 months of that decision. The appeal should be filed within the remaining name-reservation window, otherwise the name must be re-reserved after rejection or after exhaustion of the appeal. The official reconsideration fee is RMB 0, but legal counsel fees apply.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is not permissible as the sole registered office for a semiconductor WFOE. SAMR, the municipal tax authority and banks require a physical lease agreement, a registered address matching the lease and license, and actual personnel present. Some government-designated innovation or semiconductor parks allow cluster registration addresses for qualified technology companies, but this is not a virtual mailbox; banks will still require floor-level inspection, site photos and lease verification before account opening. Pure commercial mailboxes are rejected for foreign-invested finite liability companies in this industry.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist for unannounced physical inspection: (1) lease term and proof of paid rent; (2) company nameplate/signage at the registered address; (3) staff presence and attendance records; (4) office equipment, IT infrastructure and uninterrupted power; (5) registered address matching the actual operating location; (6) tax filing records and utility invoices connected to the premises; (7) bank account and registered correspondence at the same site. Quantified risk: approximately 45 to 60 percent probability of an unannounced visit by municipal market regulation or tax authorities within the first 18 months for a newly registered WFOE with a low-risk fabless semiconductor profile; risk rises to 85 percent if a second registered address is declared or any relation of the name, office, invoices or personnel is inconsistent.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff: 0; local administrative fee, if any, not to exceed RMB 300 per registration

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Home-country notary/competent authority and Chinese Embassy/Consulate if the non-member consular route applies
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official consular fee schedule plus notarial tariff; prevailing market benchmark USD 150 to 300 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation of foreign corporate registry documents into simplified Chinese for SAMR, tax and bank filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered translation company in the People's Republic of China
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark RMB 200 to 400 per page; invoice accepted by SAMR, tax authorities and banks

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office lease deposit and first six months' rent for a physical office in a designated semiconductor/technology zone
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Landlord or commercial property management company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market lease benchmark for a 30 to 50 square meter office outside Tier-1 city centers: approximately USD 600 to 800 per month plus deposit

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024), particularly Chapter II on establishment of limited liability companies and Article 47 on the subscribed capital contribution period; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (effective 1 January 2020), Articles 4, 28 and 30; and the Regulations on the Administration of Market Entities Registration and the Administrative Licensing Law of the People's Republic of China.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the local Market Regulation Administration in the jurisdiction of the registered office.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Foreign-Invested Market Entity Establishment Registration Application Form (Foreign-Invested Enterprise Business License Application).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. The subscribed capital is determined by the Articles of Association and must be fully paid within five years of incorporation under Article 47 of the Company Law. No escrow or blocked capital account is required by the registration authority; however bank counterparties may impose capital contribution verification conditions for specific corporate banking products.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF CN_WFOE_LTD. IN THE MATTER OF THE INCORPORATION AND INITIAL GOVERNANCE OF A WHOLLY FOREIGN-OWNED ENTERPRISE UNDER THE LAWS OF THE PEOPLE'S REPUBLIC OF CHINA. At a duly convened inaugural meeting of the board of directors or the sole shareholder, as applicable, duly held at the registered office of the Company on [date], with notice waived, the chair confirmed that a quorum was present and validly acting. The following resolutions were proposed, seconded, considered and unanimously adopted in accordance with the Company Law and the Articles of Association. RESOLVED, THAT the formation and registration of the Company as a wholly foreign-owned enterprise, a limited liability company under the laws of the People's Republic of China, be and the same is hereby approved, ratified and confirmed in all respects. RESOLVED, THAT the registered capital of the Company, as set forth in the Articles of Association, be and is hereby subscribed, and the initial shareholders are authorized to execute all subscription instruments, remit contributions, and record contribution receipts in the books of the Company in accordance with the capital contribution timetable. RESOLVED, THAT the registered office of the Company shall be at [address], and the officers of the Company are authorized to execute, deliver and perform the lease, utility, and all incidental agreements necessary for maintaining such registered office. RESOLVED, THAT [Name] be and is hereby appointed as legal representative, general manager and director of the Company, with full power to act for and represent the Company before the State Administration for Market Regulation, tax authorities, banks, the Ministry of Commerce, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and all other government bodies, and to execute all returns, declarations, applications, receipts, contracts, licenses and instruments necessary or convenient for the operation of the Company. RESOLVED, THAT [Name] be and is hereby appointed as the chief financial officer, and [Name] be and is hereby appointed as supervisor for the statutory term, such appointments to comply with the Articles of Association and all applicable laws. RESOLVED, THAT a basic banking account be established at [bank name] in the name of the Company, and the legal representative and the chief financial officer are authorized to open, operate and close such account, with any two signatures required for withdrawal, payment or transfer of funds. RESOLVED, THAT the approved business scope shall be fabless integrated circuit architecture design, semiconductor intellectual property core licensing, design support and related technical services, and the board shall maintain compliance with foreign investment, anti-money laundering, tax, labor, fire safety and environmental laws as applicable. RESOLVED FURTHER, THAT all acts and actions previously taken by the promoters, shareholders or officers in connection with the incorporation and pre-incorporation contracts be and are hereby approved, ratified and confirmed, and the officers be and are hereby empowered to take every further action and execute every further document that may be lawfully required to complete the registration and statutory licensing of the Company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name reservation and foreign investment negative list screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Registration Online Portal via the local Market Regulation Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before any filing, the applicant must access the designated SAMR online platform and complete the Enterprise Name Independent Selection or Pre-registration. The proposed company name should contain Semiconductor Technology or Integrated Circuit Design as the industry feature. The applicant shall also screen the most current Market Access Negative List for Foreign Investment to verify that the proposed business scope, fabless integrated circuit design and IP core licensing, falls outside any prohibited and restricted categories. The application must specify the enterprise form as a wholly foreign-owned limited liability company, proposed registered capital, legal representative, and exact business scope. The local SAMR will issue a Name Reservation Notice valid for six months. If the name contains generic, misleading or trademark-conflicting elements, it may be rejected.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form
Foreign investor identity or passport copy
Proposed business scope description
Foreign investment negative list self-declaration
Notarized authorization letter for the filing agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name reservation is rejected on grounds of conflict or misleading content, the applicant may promptly resubmit with alternate acceptable names or file an administrative reconsideration request when the rejection is legally defective.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization, apostille or legalization, and certified translation of foreign investor documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Home-jurisdiction notary public, PRC embassy or consulate, or apostille authority under the Hague Apostille Convention; local SAMR as the accepting agency
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: To establish a proper chain of title for a foreign investor, the home jurisdiction must issue certified copies of the investor's certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, and board resolution authorizing the WFOE formation. These documents must be notarized, then either apostilled under the Hague Apostille Convention or legalized by the PRC embassy or consulate. Every foreign-language document must be submitted with a Chinese translation prepared by a certified translation service, and the translator may be required to provide an affidavit confirming accuracy and completeness. The complete dossier should be assembled in original and duplicate form and retained for inspection by the local Market Regulation Administration during the registration review or if verification is requested.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation of the foreign investor, notarized and apostilled or legalized
Certificate of good standing issued within three months
Board resolution of the foreign investor approving the WFOE formation
Power of attorney and passport copies of the legal representative
Certified Chinese translation of all foreign-language documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry challenges the authenticity of any corporate document, the applicant shall obtain a re-issued certified copy from the issuing authority and, where necessary, a supplemental apostille or legalization. Defective translations shall be corrected by the certified translator and resubmitted under affidavit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment registration with the local Market Regulation Administration and issuance of the Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal or Provincial Market Regulation Administration government service center or online registration platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within the validity period of the name reservation, the applicant shall submit the establishment registration package to the local SAMR. The application form must include the appointment of the legal representative, the board members, the supervisor, the registered office lease agreement, and a copy of the title certificate for the premises. The Articles of Association must satisfy all mandatory requirements under the Company Law, including subscribed capital, contribution period, profit allocation, governance structure and winding-up provisions. SAMR will examine completeness and legality, cross-check the foreign investment negative list, and issue the Business License with a Unified Social Credit Code upon approval. That license is the proof of legal existence and the legal basis for all subsequent licensing. No official state filing fee is imposed at this stage.
required_dossiers: Foreign-Invested Market Entity Establishment Registration Application Form
Name reservation notice
Articles of Association of the WFOE
Registered office lease agreement and property ownership certificate
Appointment resolutions for the legal representative, directors and supervisor
Apostilled or legalized corporate file of the foreign investor
Certified Chinese translations
Passport copies of directors and the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SAMR issues a rectification notice, the applicant shall cure the specified defects within the statutory time limit and resubmit. If registration is refused, the applicant may apply for administrative reconsideration or initiate judicial review under the Administrative Litigation Law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation statutory filings, tax registration, bank account opening, seal registration and integrated circuit design status filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau for seal filing, local tax authority under the State Taxation Administration, commercial bank licensed by the People's Bank of China, Ministry of Commerce reporting system, and Ministry of Industry and Information Technology for optional IC design enterprise qualification
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the Business License, the company must complete the post-incorporation compliance package within 30 days. The company shall apply for official company seals, open a basic deposit account at a bank licensed in China, and complete tax, statistical and social insurance registrations with the relevant local authorities. The foreign investment information report must be submitted through the MOFCOM and SAMR integrated reporting system. Although this fabless semiconductor design company does not operate a physical factory, the business-scope wording must precisely include integrated circuit design and IP core licensing, and the company may file for MIIT integrated circuit design enterprise qualification if it intends to claim IC industry preferential tax treatment. Registered capital contributions must be evidenced before the filing of the first annual report.
required_dossiers: Business License original and copies
Unified Social Credit Code certificate
Legal representative identity documents
Seal registration certificate
Registered office lease contract
Foreign investment information report form
Bank account application package
MIIT integrated circuit design enterprise filing form if tax incentives are pursued
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any post-incorporation filing is overdue or rejected, the company should use the voluntary correction mechanism, pay any applicable late filing charges, and resubmit promptly. For bank account refusal, the company may provide a corrected banking eligibility file or apply to another licensed bank without altering the corporate structure.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the local Market Regulation Administration; Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) for integrated circuit design enterprise filing and preferential treatment; Ministry of Ecology and Environment for any future environmental assessment.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign-Invested Enterprise Business License (Market Entity Registration) with approved operating scope for semiconductor integrated circuit design and IP core licensing; no separate industrial manufacturing permit is required for fabless activities.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China (MEE) and the local Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no EIA report, environmental registration form or pollutant discharge permit is required for fabless integrated circuit design and IP core licensing because the activity does not involve physical manufacturing, chemical processes, assembly lines or warehousing with emissions.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable at present; zero wastewater discharge, zero volatile organic compound emissions and zero hazardous waste generation are expected from a pure design and IP licensing office. If the company later establishes an R&D pilot line, prototype assembly or wafer-related physical operation, it must re-assess the EIA classification and comply with applicable Integrated Wastewater Discharge Standard limits, volatile organic compound emission concentration limits, and hazardous waste manifest handling rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for a fabless design office. However, the registered office and any ancillary premises must comply with applicable PRC fire safety regulations, obtain a fire safety acceptance certificate or occupancy fire inspection qualification where required by the local Fire and Rescue Department, and satisfy workplace safety duties under the Work Safety Law for employed personnel. No civil defense fire permit is required in the absence of a physical manufacturing or warehousing facility.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China, administered through the China Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax) online platform and the competent local STA office at the WFOE's registered address.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a China-incorporated WFOE, the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) printed on the business license is the sole Tax Identification Number. The WFOE must, within 30 calendar days from the issuance of the business license, log into the STA e-Tax platform and complete the production/tax identification filing, including declaration of the financial officer and accounting system, report of bank deposit accounts, confirmation of tax collection method, and selection of VAT taxpayer status. The e-Tax system records the USCC as the taxpayer identification code used for all corporate income tax, VAT, customs export rebate, and withholding filings. A foreign non-resident enterprise with no establishment or place of business in China but deriving China-sourced income is registered by the entity that makes the withholding payment; the withholding payer files the non-resident registration using the e-Tax withholding module and the STA issues a non-resident taxpayer identification record for that purpose.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. PRC law does not provide check-the-box pass-through or hybrid mismatch elections; a WFOE is mandatorily treated as a separate entity-level taxpayer for corporate income tax and VAT. Below the RMB 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover threshold a taxpayer may elect general VAT taxpayer status, but this is an invoicing/registration status election and does not alter entity tax classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No revenue threshold for basic tax registration; every WFOE must complete tax registration within 30 days of incorporation. Mandatory general VAT taxpayer registration applies once annual taxable turnover exceeds RMB 5,000,000; small-scale VAT taxpayer treatment applies below this threshold unless general status is voluntarily elected.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China mandates real-time fiscal clearance through the STA Golden Tax Phase IV system and the Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoice (FD-EI) platform. All VAT taxpayers must issue special VAT invoices or fully digitalized e-invoices through the official e-invoice system; each invoice is digitally signed, assigned a unique invoice code and anti-counterfeiting QR code, and cleared in the STA tax cloud in near real time. ERP-to-tax-platform API integration is available for continuous transmission of invoice data. Invoices not cleared through the STA platform, not timely reported, or without the statutory digital stamp are invalid for input VAT credit, expense deduction, and export VAT refund purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible semiconductor products are zero-rated for VAT if the goods are physically exported through customs and the exporter holds the customs export declaration together with proof of foreign exchange receipt. Qualifying cross-border fabless design services, integrated circuit IP-licensing, software development, and related technological services are zero-rated when the recipient is located outside the PRC, the services/intangibles are consumed or used wholly outside China, and the taxpayer holds the cross-border contract, foreign exchange receipt evidence, and supporting proof of offshore consumption as required under Cai Shui [2016] No. 36 and the STA measures on cross-border taxable services zero-rating/exemption. The export documents must be entered in the STA export VAT refund clearing system before the 0% rate is accepted.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Goods Declaration Form)
Bill of Lading (Original, Electronic, or Air Waybill)
Export Sales Contract or Purchase Order
Foreign Exchange Receipt Record (Bank Receipt of Export Proceeds in Foreign Exchange / SAFE export proceeds monitoring declaration)
Export VAT Refund E-declaration Package Verified in the STA e-Tax System
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA and customs jointly scrutinize export zero-rating/refund claims using Golden Tax Phase IV risk analytics, export price benchmarks, inventory reconciliation, and bank foreign-exchange data. If the required customs declaration, transport documents, or foreign-exchange receipt records are missing, incomplete, fraudulent, or if export proceeds are not repatriated within the applicable deadline, the tax authority must claw back the VAT refund and reverse the zero-rating retrospectively. The taxpayer is also liable for overdue payment surcharges of 0.05% per day and an administrative penalty of not less than 50% and not more than five times the amount of tax refund falsely obtained or evaded under Article 63 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law. Fraudulent export-tax-refund schemes may additionally be prosecuted under Article 204 of the PRC Criminal Law, with criminal fines and imprisonment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a bifurcated convertibility framework. Current account transactions, including trade in goods and services, interest, dividends, and royalties, are fully convertible under a registration-based system. Authorized banks review supporting documents (contracts, invoices, customs declarations) and settle the trade in RMB or foreign currency without case-by-case SAFE approval. Capital account transactions, in contrast, remain tightly controlled and require ex-ante approval or registration with SAFE for each specific flow. For a WFOE, the initial equity investment must be registered under the FDI scheme, and subsequent capital injections, shareholder loans, and cross-border guarantees require separate registration. Dividend remittances out of audited profits are classified as current account items and are freely remittable once tax clearance and audit are completed, but banks will verify the genuineness of the prior year's financial statements and tax filings. Surrender requirements for current account receipts were abolished in stages, and now exporters may retain 100% of foreign exchange earnings in designated accounts; however, all receipts must be repatriated to China within the statutory period. Profit remittance hurdles include obtaining a recent audit report, verifying the enterprise has met its tax obligations, and demonstrating the absence of outstanding SAFE investigations. The overall system is therefore open for trade but remains a 'managed float' for capital flows, requiring strict documentation and designated bank channels.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds must be repatriated into China within 180 calendar days from the date of customs declaration (unless a longer grace is approved by SAFE). There is no mandatory percentage conversion ratio to RMB for current account export receipts; enterprises may hold 100% in foreign exchange settlement accounts or voluntarily convert. However, any non-converted balances must be utilized for bona fide trade, services, or equity-related expenditures. The historical 'surrender' obligation now only refers to the repatriation duty, with conversion at the enterprise's discretion.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (FDI Capital Account) and Basic Operational Currency Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Exchange Settlement Account and RMB Basic Deposit Account
Capital Account for Foreign Investment and Operating RMB Account
Cross-Border Settlement and FX Hedging Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. China's licensing regime requires a domestic payment institution license (PBOC) for any entity offering account-to-account transfers in CNY or holding funds for residents. Offshore fintech EMIs, such as Wise, Revolut, or Airwallex, do not hold the requisite licenses for servicing mainland entities. These platforms are legally barred from opening local currency accounts for WFOEs and cannot act as intermediaries for inbound FDI capital injections, FX settlement, or SAFE reporting. They may be used only for ancillary low-value outbound payments if the counterparty is willing to receive through their global network, but this does not constitute compliant clearing for corporate treasury. All primary banking and FX transactions must be executed through regulated domestic banks.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a standard WFOE account opening, the legal representative (Chairman or General Manager) must physically appear at the designated bank branch in Mainland China for an in-person KYC interview. No remote consular proxy opening is permitted for the primary account, although some banks may allow a notarized power of attorney for the role of financial controller or second signatory. The physical appearance requirement is strictly enforced for the initial capital account onboarding; subsequent operational account signings may be delegated. Video verification is accepted only as a supplementary check, not a substitute.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection sourced from an offshore treasury vehicle with no underlying operating history, raising concerns about scoping and legitimacy.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Parent entity's audited financial statements (last 3 years), board resolution authorizing the investment, source-of-funds bank statements for the remitting account, a group funding diagram, and a legal opinion from the remitting jurisdiction's counsel.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO or legal representative has a name-match to sanctions or PEP databases, triggering enhanced screening and possible false positive delays.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized passport copy, proof of residential address, negative news and sanctions screening report from a reputable compliance engine, a written explanation of the name-match, and if applicable, confirmation from the relevant national authority of non-association.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The fabless semiconductor design model involves high-value IP royalty payments to a related entity in a tax favorable jurisdiction, raising transfer pricing and IP valuation money-laundering risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transfer pricing documentation compliant with OECD guidelines, an independent IP valuation report, executed licensing agreements, detailed R&D activity reports, patent inventions registers, and a commercial substance description of each involved entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual frequency or value of cross-border shareholder loans and intercompany transactions that could bypass debt-to-equity ratio limits and SAFE foreign debt registration requirements.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SAFE foreign debt registration certificates, signed loan agreements, interest rate benchmark calculations, a fund utilization plan, and audited financial statements demonstrating compliance with the 2:1 debt-to-equity ratio for non-financial enterprises.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing begins with an FDI registration certificate and SAFE foreign exchange registration. The foreign investor remits the equity contribution via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 to the WFOE's designated foreign exchange capital account at a domestic Tier-1 bank. The bank debits the incoming remittance and, upon satisfaction of the authenticity and consistency check, converts the funds into RMB at the spot rate or via a settlement instruction. The capital must be used within the registered business scope. A Chinese certified public accountant must issue a capital verification report within 30 days of the contribution. All remittances must include the correct FX purpose code, typically '821011' for remittance of foreign currency investment, and the receiving bank must upload the information to the SAFE monitoring system.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For operational payments including semiconductor design tools, subcontracting, and IP royalties, use the SWIFT MT103 for high-value, low-frequency payments with full compliance screening. For procurement of manufacturing equipment and raw materials, a confirmed or unconfirmed Letter of Credit (LC) via the domestic bank's advising channel is a standard clearing rail. Documentary collections are less common but acceptable for small-value regular settlements. All outbound transfers must be supported by underlying contracts, invoices, and customs records to pass the bank's current account veracity review.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore CNY deliverable forward contracts are permitted for the WFOE's real trade or capital flows, with a bank facility line and no speculative positioning; tenors are typically up to 12 months, extendable to 18-24 months for project-related exposures.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not available onshore for CNY because the currency is not fully convertible and the onshore deliverable forward market already exists; offshore NDFs are outside the SAFE licensing boundary and cannot be settled with domestic CNY liquidity, therefore only onshore deliverable forwards or option alternatives are permissible.

Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) are permissible strictly for hedging future foreign-currency debt service or investment cash flows, with a demonstrated underlying exposure, and must be transacted through a licensed domestic bank and reported to the China Foreign Exchange Trade System (CFETS).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Report for each prior calendar year during the statutory window from 1 January to 30 June each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file by the 30 June deadline places the WFOE on the AMR's List of Enterprises Operating under Abnormal Conditions; after three consecutive years of non-rectification, the entity is listed as Serious Illegal and Dishonest with revocation of business licence; administrative fines may be imposed under the Interim Regulations on Enterprise Information Publicity, and the credit rating is downgraded.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Settlement Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) - competent local tax office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 May of the immediately following tax year (fiscal year ends 31 December)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late settlement triggers overdue tax interest at 0.05% per calendar day of unpaid tax, late filing penalty of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000, and understatement penalty of 50% to 100% of tax deficiency; severe or persistent non-compliance leads to compulsory collection, freeze of bank accounts, and blocking of tax credit and export rebates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Annual Information Report (Joint Annual Report for WFOE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration for Market Regulation (data shared with Ministry of Commerce and State Administration of Foreign Exchange)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from 1 January to 30 June covering the prior calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Rectification order and fine up to RMB 50,000 for concealment or false report; the WFOE may be placed in the abnormal list and denied foreign exchange repatriation, shareholder loan settlement, and dividend remittance operations.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under the PRC Company Law, Foreign Investment Law and the Certified Public Accountants Law, a WFOE must engage a PRC-licensed independent CPA firm for an annual statutory audit without exception. Additional quantitative triggers that make the audit fileable and require public disclosure include any one of: balance sheet total assets exceeding RMB 50 million, annual business revenue exceeding RMB 20 million, or average annual headcount exceeding 200. Any enterprise meeting these thresholds is classified as a medium or large enterprise under the PRC SME classification standards and is subject to mandatory audit opinion to the tax and credit authorities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE/PRC GAAP), which are substantially convergent with IFRS; IFRS is permitted for intercompany consolidation at the foreign parent level but not for the PRC statutory financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The annual Enterprise Information Report and Foreign Investment Annual Report must identify the ultimate beneficial owner (natural person) of the foreign investor and any change in direct or indirect shareholding. Equity transfers or capital reductions are required to be filed with the AMR and the tax authority for withholding within 30 days of the transaction. The WFOE must maintain current UBO data at the registered office, and banks must refresh this data under the PRC anti-money laundering rules whenever there is a shareholding resegmentation or transfer of more than 10%.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% preferential rate for High and New Technology Enterprises (HNTE); further incentives for qualified IC design enterprises, including a 2-year exemption and 3-year half reduction from the first profit-making year; additional deduction for R&D expenses equal to 200% of qualifying R&D costs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: PRC Corporate Income Tax Annual Return (Form A, 2017 version), filed electronically via the State Taxation Administration (STA) e-Tax filing portal (the electronic taxation system of the STA).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Final annual return must be filed within five months after the fiscal year-end (generally by 31 May); quarterly provisional prepayments are due within 15 days after the end of each calendar quarter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total declared business revenue and other operating income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all China-sourced and foreign-sourced income of the WFOE as a resident enterprise. Foreign-source dividends and royalties must be grossed up for foreign tax and included; claim applicable foreign tax credit in Box 6. For outbound payments to foreign affiliates, ensure the WFOE is acting as a withholding agent and report the gross payment amounts in the accompanying WHT schedules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total deductible costs, expenses, and losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct ordinary and necessary expenses allocable to gross income. Disallow intercompany royalties or interest if not at arm's length or if the beneficial owner of such payments is not a tax resident under a DTA. Entertainments, donations, and fines exceeding statutory caps must be added back.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profit after add-backs and loss adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile accounting profit to taxable income. Apply transfer pricing adjustments where the WFOE has failed to price cross-border IP licensing or intercompany services at arm's length. If loss carryforward claimed, ensure no more than 5 years have elapsed since the loss year.

Enter the portion of prior-year losses available to offset current-year profit. Losses from foreign permanent establishments may only offset China-source profit. Retain roll-forward workpapers for audit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Preferential tax rate and reduced-rate form header.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select the applicable HNTE 15% rate or the IC design enterprise regime, if certification and substantive R&D activities in China are satisfied. The reduction cannot be claimed merely because the ultimate parent is foreign; the WFOE must be validly certified before any rate relief.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credit and withholding credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim a credit for foreign income taxes paid on foreign-source inclusions, capped at the PRC tax payable on the foreign income. For Chinese WHT on outbound dividends, interest, and royalties, record such withholding in the corresponding declaration schedules, and, if treaty relief has already been granted, attach the approved DTA application and the foreign shareholder's Tax Residency Certificate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing is subject to a penalty of RMB 2,000-10,000 and an overdue interest surcharge of 0.05% per day on the unpaid tax. Understatement or omission of tax through fraud or false returns triggers a 50%-500% surcharge, criminal prosecution for tax evasion, and public listing of serious tax violations; the legal representative's passport may be blocked at exit.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% under PRC domestic law (Corporate Income Tax Law Article 3 and Article 37) for dividends distributed to a non-resident shareholder, unless reduced by the applicable bilateral tax treaty.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim DTA relief, the non-resident shareholder must provide (1) a current Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by its home jurisdiction's tax authority, (2) a Beneficial Owner declaration confirming it meets the treaty ownership and substance requirements, and (3) complete STA Form A (non-resident income withholding reduction/exemption application). The WFOE must submit this documentation to the competent Chinese tax authority before or at the time of making the remittance. Reduced treaty rates (e.g., 5% for direct dividend ownership over 25% under many DTA, or 0% for Hong Kong companies satisfying the 25% test) may be applied only after approval or on a provisional basis with full ex-post documentation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory rate: 10% for royalties and 10% for interest. Under most Chinese DTA, treaty rates are 10% for interest and 10% for royalties; certain royalty types (e.g., copyright royalties for books or software) may enter a 5% fiscal-resident-completed holding test. For a fabless IP licensing business, royalties for semiconductor IP core licenses are technical royalties and usually benefit from a 10% treaty cap.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is mandatory when any annual related-party transaction threshold is exceeded: RMB 100 million for tangible property transfers, RMB 50 million for intangible property transfers, RMB 100 million for financial asset transfers, and RMB 100 million for related services. Master File is mandatory when the MNE group's consolidated revenue exceeds RMB 2 billion. The fabless WFOE must also file the annual Related Party Transaction Report (Form G100000) regardless of the threshold.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The PRC has no standalone Economic Substance Regulation (ESR), but the anti-abuse rules (EIT Law Article 47) and the general anti-avoidance rule (GAAR, Article 120 of the Implementing Regulations) deny treaty and statutory benefits to shell arrangements. The revenue authority reviews Core Income-Generating Activities (CIGA) in China: for a fabless design enterprise, the design team, R&D control, and IP management must have real functions, assets, and risks in China. Without active personnel and physical operations in China, treaty relief may be denied and a 50%-500% penalty applied.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Underreporting of domestic and foreign royalties, especially licensing income related to semiconductor IP cores, or deliberately omitting deemed taxable income derived from the WFOE's overseas digital sales and funding flows.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Articles 63 and 64 of the Law of the PRC on the Administration of Tax Collection: payment of the underpaid tax plus a penalty of 50%-5 times the amount of the underpaid tax, and daily late surcharge of 0.05%.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative and supervising director may be jointly and severally liable for restitution of the underpaid tax and can be subjected to exit denial (blacklisting) by the tax administration for undeclared balances; egregious fraud can trigger criminal tax evasion under Article 201 of the Criminal Law, with imprisonment of up to 7 years and fines.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer pricing manipulation and thin capitalization
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Baseless pricing for intercompany royalty and licensing arrangements, or holding a structurally debt-heavy capitalization with high interest deductions used to strip profit from the Chinese design entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Article 41 of the EIT Law and the Special Tax Adjustment Measures (STA Announcement 6 of 2017), the tax authority may re-determine taxable income and impose a 5-year interest surcharge plus a penalty of 50%-500% of the additional tax where transactions are found not at arm's length.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: If the WFOE is insolvent and cannot pay the adjusted liability, the director/controller may be directly liable to creditors and to the tax authority for fraudulent conveyance; criminal consequences apply where illicit profit shifting is used with intent to evade tax, leading to personal asset seizure and imprisonment for up to 7 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company and DTA relief abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creation of the WFOE as a shell IP-holding vehicle without substantive functions, assets, or employee activity, used exclusively to access tax treaty benefits (e.g., lower withholding rate through a Hong Kong intermediate) and avoid PRC dividends tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 47 (EIT Law) and Article 120 of the Implementing Regulations empower the STA to apply a general anti-avoidance adjustment, recharacterize the transaction, and impose a penalty of 50%-500% of the tax understated, plus interest; denial of treaty relief with retrospective effect.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under the Company Law and financial supervisory rules, directors may be held personally civilly liable for the failure of the entity; for cross-border fraud, the same acts can result in placing the director on the STA's serious taxpayer list, which blocks exit from China, freezes personal bank accounts, and exposes the director to extradition if money laundering is also proven.
